tests.expect: (()=>{const p=document.getElementById('g3Pop');if(!p)return 'no pop';const t=p.querySelectorAll('.g3pf[data-f="t"] .it'),w=p.querySelectorAll('.g3pf[data-f="w"] .it');const all=[...t,...w];return all.length>0&&all.every(x=>{const n=x.querySelector('.g3pn');return n&&+n.textContent>=1})?true:('t'+t.length+' w'+w.length+' 숫자 '+all.filter(x=>x.querySelector('.g3pn')).length)})()
